description: Read-only code reviews, design reviews and analyses by another agent family through Cowboy managed calls.
guidance: Prefer Cowboy MCP for state/control; CLI fallback. Review is optional: review.start at most once per task for costly security, permissions, concurrency, persistence, deletion, money or large-refactor risks your checks cannot rule out. Skip small/mechanical/docs/test-only/exploratory work. Load actions help on demand; inspect calls.result before reporting. CLI: `cowboy review` (user-requested: `cowboy review --ask`). Fix valid findings; keep skips/missing commands silent. Other delegation: MCP calls.start; fallback `cowboy {{peer_command}} --help`. Never launch hidden `codex exec`, `codex review` or `claude -p`.
